# Amayas Swahili Kitchen

Amayas Swahili Kitchen is an authentic Swahili restaurant located in Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya. We serve traditional Swahili cuisine including pilau, biryani, nyama choma, and fresh seafood dishes.

## Location
Titan Complex, Chaka Road, Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya

## Contact
Phone: +254 718 414667
WhatsApp: 254718414667

## Hours
Open Daily: 7:00 AM – 9:30 PM
